title: The Kusner conjecture
exact_target: Can there ever be more than twice the dimension many mutually equidistant points in a real space with the sum-of-coordinate-distances metric?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200051 (AMR-071-0051). CC BY 4.0.
